IN CASE YOU MISSED IT: Natalana nga power interruption bwas nga adlaw, SEPTEMBER 19, 2026 (Saturday)
Yari ang detalye sang power advisory.

NGCP MAPATIGAYON SANG SHUTDOWN SANG BACOLOD-SILAY 69KVA LINE SA SEPTEMBER 19, 2026 (Saturday)
Mapatigayon ang National Grid Corporation of the Philippines (NGCP) sang shutdown sang Bilog nga Talisay Substation, bilog nga Lopez Substation, kag bilog nga Panaogao Substation sa Septyembre  19, 2026 (Sabado), halin alas-4 sang hapon tubtob alas-6 sang gab-i. Ini nga scheduled interruption gin-request bangod magapatigayon ang NGCP sang 69kV line maintenance.
Yari ang detalye sang power interruption:
Reason : NGCP request of BCD-SILAY 69kV Line Shutdown.
Time & Affected Areas:
4:00PM to 6:00PM
